name: llm-kit
description: Monorepo of six focused, dependency-light npm packages for LLM application plumbing.

scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r run typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:scripts
scripts.test: pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 run test && pnpm run test:scripts
scripts.validate: pnpm run validate:boundaries && pnpm run validate:metadata
scripts.ci: pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:coverage && pnpm run test:scripts && pnpm run validate && pnpm run validate:readme && pnpm run validate:artifacts && pnpm run smoke:browser && pnpm audit --prod --audit-level high
scripts.release: pnpm run build && pnpm run validate:metadata:pre-publish && changeset publish
